guides.conceptEn: Connect concrete armour material quality, geometry and placed contacts through traceable verification. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：消波塊製作與安放
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement
guides.concept: 把消波構件的材料品質、形狀與安放接觸連成可追溯驗證。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
guides.conceptEn: Connect concrete armour material quality, geometry and placed contacts through traceable verification. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
procedure: 混凝土消波構件的質量影響水下有效重量，但水工功能還取決於形狀、接觸和孔隙。從密度換算體積只是一致性檢查，不能由相同噸數推定不同專利形狀的穩定性相同，也不能取代裂縫和缺角檢查。 假設乾質量3000kg、材料密度2400kg/m³，實體V=M/ρ=1.25m³；海水1025kg/m³時有效重為16.86kN，非產品規格。 質量驗證也應保留水下有效重的定義，浸水可達孔隙會影響排水體積。
配比中的有效用水量要考慮骨材吸水與表面水，不是水表讀值單獨決定。水膠比與工作性、強度和耐久性相關，但本課示意只追蹤收支，不能由一個比值保證大型異形構件內部密實。 假設膠材340kg、加入水170kg，其中8kg被乾骨材吸收且無表面水，有效水膠比(170−8)/340=0.4765；非配方建議。 膠材不一定只有水泥，計算分母需要遵循核准配比中對膠材的明確定義。
大型混凝土構件的表面與內部溫度歷程不同，均勻自由伸縮只能提供基礎量級。若存在溫度梯度或模具約束，就會額外產生應力；把自由變形算式誤當成裂縫預測會遺漏養護和形狀的作用。 假設α=10⁻⁵/K、均勻溫差25K、長L=2m，自由變形ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm；不含約束。 膨脹係數也可能因骨材而異，模型固定係數不等於所有混凝土都具有相同熱行為。
約束會把熱收縮轉換成拉應力，但混凝土齡期、徐變、開裂和約束鬆弛都使反應隨時間變化。完全約束線彈性式只用來比較量級，不能把固定彈性模數一路套到所有養護階段或實際裂縫寬度。 假設E=25GPa、α=10⁻⁵/K、完全約束冷卻25K，σ=EαΔT=6.25MPa拉應力；實際開裂與徐變需另算。 抗拉能力也隨齡期改變，應力和抗力需在相同時間比較才有物理意義。
抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。試體與構件的溫度歷程、密實度和尺度不同，因此名義抗壓值不能代表全部構造能力。 假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。 試體平均值與特徵值的統計意義不同，樣本數及離散程度需另外明列。
消波構件的吊點與重心受複雜形狀影響，索力會因夾角增加而上升。理想兩索靜力分析需同時滿足對稱與共同受力，不能取代專用吊具、動載和早齡期材料能力的核准檢查。 假設質量3000kg、兩索各與垂直45°且靜態對稱，T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN；未含動載或偏心。 吊點局部作用還取決於嵌件與混凝土的傳力，單一索力不能證明錨定合格。
安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。每平方米的件數不能直接換成孔隙率，也不能只增加件數就期待水工功能改善，過密可能改變透流與局部架空。 假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。 實際斜面和水平面積的選擇會改變名義件數密度，跨專案比較要先統一定義。
水下安放需把位置誤差與姿態誤差分開，三維坐標偏差小不代表接觸臂方向正確。測量基準、船體姿態和吊具桿臂都會影響重建位置，圖上的點位必須能追溯到構件的特定參考點。 假設參考點偏差Δx=0.10m、Δy=0.20m、Δz=0.05m，距離e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m；不是姿態誤差。 位置距離是三維向量的長度，不會保留偏移方向，方向仍需另行記錄。
幾何縮尺構件的體積按長度三次方變化，相同材料密度才可直接使用相同質量比。實體試驗還需維持相對密度、表面粗糙和接觸方式，不能只做外形相似卻讓有效重量與摩擦特性失去對應。 假設原型質量3000kg、長度比20且材料密度相同，模型質量3000/20³=0.375kg；同時需檢查水下相對密度。 模型接觸面若相對粗糙過大，摩擦行為可能與原型不同，即使質量縮尺正確。
表面磨耗可能改變邊角和接觸粗糙度，試驗質量損失提供材料比較，卻不是直接的年損耗率。試驗介質、撞擊能量和時間與現地不同，必須把可重現的試驗排序與實際耐久機制分開。 假設試樣乾質量1.000kg，指定磨耗試驗後0.950kg，損失(1−0.95)/1=5%；不能直接推成每年損失5%。 耐久判讀還需要考慮鹽害與濕乾循環，機械磨耗不是唯一材料退化途徑。
procedureEn: Concrete-unit mass influences submerged weight, while hydraulic behavior also depends on shape, contacts and voids. Density-to-volume conversion is a consistency check, not evidence that different proprietary shapes with equal tonnage have equal stability or freedom from cracking and missing corners. Assume mass3000kg and density2400kg/m³: solid V=1.25m³. In seawater1025kg/m³ effective weight is16.86kN; these are not product specifications. Mass checks must retain the submerged-weight definition because water-accessible voids can affect the displaced volume used for buoyancy calculation.

Effective mix water depends on aggregate absorption and surface moisture, not just the metered addition. Water-to-binder ratio relates to workability, strength and durability, but this illustration tracks accounting only; one ratio cannot guarantee consolidation inside a large complex unit. Assume binder340kg and water170kg, with8kg absorbed by dry aggregate and no surface water. Effective ratio=(170−8)/340=0.4765, not a mix recommendation. Binder need not consist only of cement; the calculation denominator must follow the explicit binder definition in the approved mixture.

The surface and core of a large unit follow different temperature histories. Uniform free expansion supplies a basic scale only; gradients or mould restraint generate additional stress. Treating free movement as a crack prediction omits curing conditions and geometric effects. Assumeα=10⁻⁵/K, uniform change25K and length2m. Free movement ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm, excluding restraint. Thermal expansion depends on aggregate as well, so a fixed coefficient in the example does not imply identical behavior for every concrete.

Restraint converts thermal contraction into tension, but concrete age, creep, cracking and restraint relaxation change response over time. A fully restrained elastic estimate compares scales only; fixed modulus cannot represent every curing stage or directly predict the resulting crack width. Assume E=25GPa,α=10⁻⁵/K and fully restrained cooling25K. Elastic tensionσ=EαΔT=6.25MPa; cracking and creep require separate treatment. Tensile resistance changes with age too; comparing stress and resistance at the same time is necessary for a physically meaningful interpretation.

Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension. Their temperature histories, consolidation and size differ, so nominal compressive strength cannot describe every structural capacity of the full unit. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength. A specimen mean and a characteristic value have different statistical meanings, requiring separate statements of sample size and observed variability.

Complex geometry affects lifting points and gravity center, and sling force rises with inclination. An ideal two-sling static model requires symmetry and simultaneous engagement; it does not replace approved checks of lifting equipment, dynamics and early-age material capacity. Assume mass3000kg and two symmetric static slings45° from vertical. T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN, excluding dynamics and eccentricity. Local attachment behavior depends on force transfer through inserts and concrete; one sling-force result cannot establish adequate anchorage performance.

Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts. Units per square metre cannot be directly converted into porosity, and adding more units need not improve performance because overly dense placement can alter flow and create unsupported contacts. Assume200 units cover1000m² in one layer. Placement density is0.20units/m²; without volume and thickness it does not determine porosity. Choosing actual slope area versus horizontal projection changes nominal placement density, so comparisons across projects require a consistent denominator first.

Underwater placement separates position error from orientation error; small coordinate deviation does not establish correct contact-arm direction. Survey datum, vessel attitude and rig lever arms affect reconstruction, so each plotted position must refer to a defined point on the actual unit. Assume reference-point offsets0.10m,0.20m and0.05m. Distance e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m does not describe orientation error. Position distance is the magnitude of a three-dimensional vector and does not preserve direction, which must therefore remain separately recorded.

Geometrically scaled units change volume with the cube of length, and equal material density permits the same mass ratio. Physical tests also require appropriate relative density, roughness and contacts; matching the silhouette alone does not preserve submerged weight or interface behavior. Assume prototype mass3000kg, length ratio20 and equal material density. Model mass=3000/20³=0.375kg, with submerged relative density checked separately. Excessive relative roughness at model contacts can alter friction even when the mass scaling is correct for the chosen geometry.

Abrasion can alter corners and contact roughness. Test mass loss compares material response but is not a direct annual wear rate. Media, impact energy and duration differ from service, so reproducible laboratory ranking must remain separate from the mechanisms governing real durability. Assume dry sample1.000kg and0.950kg after a specified abrasion test. Loss is5%, which cannot be interpreted as5% annual service loss. Durability interpretation must also consider salt exposure and wet-dry cycling, because mechanical abrasion is not the sole material deterioration mechanism.
evidence: 將每一代表構件的秤重、體積和含水狀態對照，查看模具尺寸及外觀紀錄是否相符。另以設計採用的形狀分類檢查接觸，避免僅用質量取代完整幾何驗證。
分別記錄骨材含水、吸水試驗和加水量，說明哪些水被計入有效水量。核對工作性與代表試體，不以現場臨時加水改善外觀而略過核准配比和追溯紀錄。
在厚部與細臂配置相對應的溫度紀錄，區分均勻降溫與內外梯度。將實測變形和模具接觸狀態一起比較，確認採用自由膨脹假設的區段是否真的未受拘束。
記錄溫度、齡期及模具或基座約束，檢查模型採用的彈性模數與實際時間是否一致。用裂縫位置和發展時序比較可能機制，不以一個理想應力直接宣告構件可用。
核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。另檢查細臂、轉角與吊點的受力模式，避免讓抗壓試驗代替必要的材料或構造驗證。
evidenceEn: Compare representative unit weight, volume and moisture state with mould and visual records. Independently check contact behavior for the specified shape family rather than substituting mass measurement for complete geometric verification.

Record aggregate moisture, absorption testing and added water separately, identifying effective-water assumptions. Check workability and representative specimens without treating unrecorded field water addition as an acceptable substitute for the approved mixture.

Compare temperature histories in thick portions and slender arms, separating uniform cooling from gradients. Relate measured movement to mould contact and verify that portions modeled as freely expanding actually lack significant restraint.

Record temperature, age and mould or base restraint and match modulus to the relevant time. Compare crack locations and chronology with competing mechanisms rather than declaring a unit acceptable from one ideal elastic stress.

Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch. Separately review slender arms, corners and lifting points so compression testing does not replace other necessary material or structural verification.
pitfalls: 缺角可能只減少少量質量卻破壞主要接觸臂，密度平均值因此仍合格。若只按噸數出廠，安放後互鎖下降可能直到暴風才被發現，修復亦更困難。
表面已降溫而核心仍熱時，單一平均溫度會掩蓋內外應變差；局部細臂可能先裂。即使外部總長變化很小，也不能據此排除內部自平衡熱應力。
試體養護較好時可能高估構件內部品質，局部蜂窩又未必出現在取樣中；平均抗壓值達標仍可能伴隨吊運破裂或安放後接觸臂損傷。
高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。只驗收總數量，不能確認荷載和互鎖已沿斷面連續傳遞。
用低密度列印件卻只按長度縮小，模型可能比原型容易移動；額外加重若集中在一點又會改變重心。質量吻合仍不足以證明動態轉動完全相似。
pitfallsEn: A missing corner may remove little mass but destroy an important contact arm while average density still passes. Mass-only release can conceal reduced interlock until a storm reveals a defect that is then harder to repair.

A cooled surface with a warm core creates strain differences hidden by average temperature, potentially cracking slender arms first. Small overall length change does not exclude internal self-equilibrating thermal stress within the unit.

Better specimen curing can overstate actual unit quality, and sampling may miss local honeycombing. A passing mean compressive strength can coexist with lifting fractures or damaged contact arms after placement at the site.

Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. Total quantity alone does not establish continuous contact, load transfer or interlocking along the section.

Low-density printed units scaled only by length can move more readily than the prototype. Concentrated added weight changes gravity center, so even a matching total mass does not establish dynamically similar rotation of the unit.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 拋石防波堤施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「質量與排水體積」與「安放密度與孔隙」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；拋石防波堤施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Mass and displaced volume" and "Placement density and voids" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rubble-mound breakwater construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把消波構件的材料品質、形狀與安放接觸連成可追溯驗證；拋石防波堤施工則以連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on connect concrete armour material quality, geometry and placed contacts through traceable verification; Rubble-mound breakwater construction centres on understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「質量與排水體積」與「水下有效重量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到拋石防波堤施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「流速造成阻力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Mass and displaced volume” and “Submerged effective weight”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rubble-mound breakwater construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Current-induced drag", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 消波塊製作與安放
history.text: 本課以不同用途的混凝土海事構件對照材料與形狀的重要性，不把所有消波塊視為同一產品。美國官方目錄列二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊；新加坡在二〇一六年記錄大士港首座沉箱，提供大型混凝土製造的比較背景。荷蘭主管機關二〇二五年介紹阿夫魯戴克專用護面構件的粗糙外形與空隙，說明形狀、水理和安放接觸需要一起處理。碼頭沉箱不是消波塊，兩者只在材料生產與追溯觀念上比較。課程所有配比、質量及試驗值都是合成假設，並非專利構件的製造規格或專案驗收標準。
history.textEn: The course compares concrete maritime components to show why material and shape both matter, rather than treating every armour unit as one product. USACE lists its Coastal Engineering Manual in2002. Singapore records the first Tuas caisson in2016, providing a large-concrete fabrication comparison. In2025 the Dutch owner described roughness and voids in dedicated Afsluitdijk armour elements, linking shape, hydraulics and contacts. A quay caisson is not an armour block; the comparison concerns production and traceability only. Every mixture, mass and test value in the lessons is synthetic, not a proprietary manufacturing specification or project acceptance criterion.
